meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写可 seek 的 2D/3D 关键帧：推拉、缩放、重新构图、Ken Burns 镜头位移等，再用 hyperframes lint、check、keyframes 逐帧验证动画。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉、缩放、Ken Burns 等可 seek 关键帧动画时接管；不用于宽泛场景策略、品牌设计、字幕或整体视频规划。

say.text: 给这个镜头做一个 punch-in 关键帧动效
say.note: 它会用 scale 加位移关键帧实现推镜

say.text: 把这段多状态缩放做成一条可 seek 的关键帧序列
say.note: 它会保持同一主体，逐段设缓动

say.text: 用 hyperframes keyframes --shot 验证这个动画
say.note: 它会输出关键帧诊断与快照

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: punch-ins, zooms, reframes, Ken Burns camera moves and more, then verifies them with hyperframes lint, check and keyframes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns or other seek-safe keyframes. Not for broad scene strategy, brand design, captions or video planning.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe move to this shot
say_en.note: It keys scale plus x/y translation

say_en.text: Turn this multi-state zoom into one seek-safe keyframe ladder
say_en.note: It keeps one subject with per-segment easing

say_en.text: Verify this animation with hyperframes keyframes --shot
say_en.note: It outputs keyframe diagnostics and snapshots
